name: Sunburst Correlation DLL and Network Event
reason: Both hardcoded strings are attacker-chosen artifacts of the SUNBURST campaign specifically: the trojanized DLL name and the one C2 domain that campaign registered. A different vendor's update mechanism trojanized by a different actor produces neither string. Also mistagged: carries T1203 (Exploitation for Client Execution), not any T1195 sub-technique, despite being the canonical supply chain detection in this repo.

name: Shai-Hulud Workflow File Creation or Modification
reason: Matches on the literal workflow file names this specific worm creates (shai-hulud-workflow.yml, discussion.yaml, formatter_*.yml). A different npm worm that names its malicious workflow file anything else does not match.

name: Shai-Hulud 2 Exfiltration Artifact Files
search_fragment_basis: Filesystem.file_name IN (cloud.json, contents.json, environment.json, truffleSecrets.json, actionsSecrets.json)
reason: Matches on the exact staging filenames this malware's authors chose. A different npm-worm exfiltration step using different filenames does not match.

name: GitHub Workflow File Creation or Modification
reason: Matches on ANY workflow file creation/modification under .github/workflows, a structural location GitHub itself defines for CI/CD, not a name the Shai-Hulud authors chose. Fires on any future attacker who drops a workflow file there, named anything.

name: Python Network Traffic During Package Build
reason: Matches the generic behavioral pattern of a Python process opening a network connection during the build_wheel phase of package installation. No package name, domain, or file name from any specific incident appears in the search.

name: Python PTH File Creation During Package Installation
reason: Matches on the generic .pth file extension and install-time process pattern. The description names the litellm/TeamPCP incident as the motivating example, but no litellm-specific string appears in the search logic itself.

name: Python PYTHONPATH Modification During Package Installation
reason: Matches on the PYTHONPATH environment variable and pip's install-time parent process path, both generic to the Python packaging mechanism, not to one incident's indicators.

name: Python Site Hooks Creation During Package Installation
reason: Matches on the two file names Python's own site module looks for (a language mechanism, not an attacker-chosen name), during install. The description cites VIPERTUNNEL as a real-world example, but the search has no VIPERTUNNEL-specific string.

name: Hunting 3CXDesktopApp Software
reason: Matches on the literal product name of the one vulnerable application (3CXDesktopApp.exe). A different trojanized desktop application ships under a different binary name and this search will not fire on it. The known_false_positives field itself acknowledges the detection is really an asset inventory hunt for this one product, not a behavioral pattern.

name: Windows Vulnerable 3CX Software
reason: Matches on the exact product binary name and the exact vulnerable version range (18.12.407 / 18.12.416) of one application. Cannot generalize to any other vendor's trojanized update.

name: 3CX Supply Chain Attack Network Indicators
search_fragment_basis: lookup 3cx_ioc_domains domain as query OUTPUT Description isIOC | search isIOC=true
reason: The entire detection logic is a lookup against a curated domain IOC list built specifically for the 3CX campaign. Swapping in a different campaign's C2 domains would require rebuilding the lookup table; the search itself carries no technique-level logic.

name: GitHub Enterprise Delete Branch Ruleset
reason: Matches GitHub's own audit-log action name for deleting a branch protection ruleset, a platform administrative action any attacker (in any future supply chain compromise via a compromised maintainer or CI credential) would have to invoke through the same API call to remove that protection. No incident-specific string.

name: GitHub Enterprise Disable 2FA Requirement
reason: Platform audit-log action name for disabling org-wide 2FA enforcement. Generic to any attacker who takes this step to weaken account security ahead of or during a supply chain compromise.

name: GitHub Enterprise Disable Audit Log Event Stream
reason: Platform audit-log action name for turning off log export. Generic anti-forensics step usable by any attacker, not tied to one incident's IOCs.

name: GitHub Enterprise Disable Classic Branch Protection Rule
reason: Platform audit-log action for removing branch protection. Generic administrative action, not an incident-specific indicator.

name: GitHub Enterprise Disable Dependabot
reason: Platform audit-log action for disabling Dependabot alerts. Any attacker suppressing dependency-vulnerability alerts in any future incident invokes this same API action.

name: GitHub Enterprise Disable IP Allow List
reason: Platform audit-log action for disabling the IP allowlist. Generic access-control-weakening step, not tied to a specific campaign's indicators.

name: GitHub Enterprise Modify Audit Log Event Stream
reason: Platform audit-log action for changing (not necessarily disabling) the log stream config. Generic, applies to any attacker touching this setting.

name: GitHub Enterprise Pause Audit Log Event Stream
reason: Same platform action as the modify detection, filtered to the pause reason code GitHub itself assigns. Still platform vocabulary, not an attacker-chosen string.

name: GitHub Enterprise Register Self-Hosted Runner
reason: Platform audit-log action for registering a CI runner, the same mechanism Shai-Hulud 2.0 abused by registering runners named SHA1HULUD, but this search matches the registration action itself, not that specific runner name, so it also catches a future attacker registering a runner under any other name.

name: GitHub Enterprise Remove Organization
reason: Platform audit-log action for removing an org from an enterprise account. Generic destructive administrative action.

name: GitHub Enterprise Repository Archived
reason: Platform audit-log action for archiving a repo. Generic, not incident-specific.

name: GitHub Enterprise Repository Deleted
reason: Platform audit-log action for deleting a repo. Generic, not incident-specific.

name: GitHub Organizations Delete Branch Ruleset
reason: Same platform action as the Enterprise variant, via the Organizations audit log product surface. Generic.

name: GitHub Organizations Disable 2FA Requirement
reason: Same reasoning as the Enterprise 2FA detection: platform action name, generic.

name: GitHub Organizations Disable Classic Branch Protection Rule
reason: Same reasoning as the Enterprise branch-protection detection: platform action name, generic.

name: GitHub Organizations Disable Dependabot
reason: Same reasoning as the Enterprise Dependabot detection: platform action name, generic.

name: GitHub Organizations Repository Archived
reason: Same reasoning as the Enterprise archive detection: platform action name, generic.

name: GitHub Organizations Repository Deleted
reason: Same reasoning as the Enterprise delete detection: platform action name, generic.
